value.name: Active Surveillance
value.description: This approach involves regular monitoring of benign nodules through ultrasound and physical exams to check for changes in size or appearance. It is typically recommended for small, asymptomatic nodules that do not show suspicious features on initial biopsy.

value.name: Levothyroxine Suppression Therapy
value.description: This treatment involves taking synthetic thyroid hormone to suppress Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone (TSH) levels, which may help shrink certain nodules. While less common now due to potential side effects, it is sometimes used for specific benign nodules in iodine-deficient regions.

value.name: Radioactive Iodine Therapy
value.description: This treatment is primarily used for hyperfunctioning or 'hot' nodules that produce excessive thyroid hormone. The radioactive iodine is absorbed by the overactive thyroid tissue, causing the nodule to shrink and hormone levels to normalize.

value.name: Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA)
value.description: RFA is a minimally invasive procedure that uses thermal energy to destroy nodule tissue without the need for traditional surgery. It is highly effective for reducing the size of large, symptomatic benign nodules and improving cosmetic appearance.

value.name: Ethanol Ablation
value.description: This procedure involves injecting medical-grade ethanol directly into a nodule, primarily used for fluid-filled thyroid cysts. The alcohol causes the cyst walls to collapse and scar, preventing the re-accumulation of fluid.

value.name: Thyroid Lobectomy
value.description: This surgical procedure involves removing only the half of the thyroid gland containing the nodule. It is often performed for nodules that are indeterminate or suspicious for malignancy but confined to one lobe.

value.name: Total Thyroidectomy
value.description: This is the complete removal of the thyroid gland, usually reserved for large multinodular goiters or confirmed thyroid cancer. Patients who undergo this surgery will require lifelong thyroid hormone replacement therapy.

value.name: Laser Ablation
value.description: Similar to RFA, laser ablation uses light energy delivered through thin fibers to generate heat and destroy nodule tissue. It is an effective non-surgical option for reducing the volume of benign solid thyroid nodules.
